pages.text: When held in the main or off hand, you can open a Trapped Chest without the chest firing off a redstone signal.

When used to upgrade a $(l:blocks/radiant_trove)Radiant Trove$(), the item type held by the trove becomes fixed. Even if the Trove's internal storage is reduced to 0 items, it reserves its storage for that type of item only.
pages.title: Radiant Trove
